## F — Licensing and graduated permits
Research inventory: 30 primary rule blocks in C and 25 continuation blocks in C2, each with an exact physical-page anchor.
VERIFY: NE-sec01-PASS covers absent official exam counts, scoring and time limits; NE-sec01-CURRENCY covers unaccepted edition evidence and unknown revision frequency.
NE-sec01-MARKET covers unresearched market demand; NE-sec01-TEARDOWN covers unresearched competitor comparisons.
The extraction substitutes a digit for some fi ligatures; clear words are paraphrased, garbled claims withheld. Fees and live service eligibility are not stable learning facts.
The source map and authorship record remain local; the deterministic compiler indexes the exact accepted fact sentences.
